title: Concept: Module with no toolchain directive
description: go.mod declares a go.mod that names no toolchain, so the local one decides, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a go.mod that names no toolchain, so the local one decides.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.mod (go).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a go.mod that names no toolchain, so the local one decides.
